assets.title: Pneumatic Verdict
assets.prompt: Original instrumental short combat music cue for THE NINTH EXHALE, a grim retro-futurist industrial biohorror first-person action RPG. Relentless 1980s analog techno-industrial energy with the aggression and urgency of heavy metal, 145 BPM. Hammering gated drum machine and distorted industrial percussion, sinister pulsing analog bass sequencer, razor-edged FM synth stabs, detuned minor-key arpeggios, brief menacing machine-choir textures, pounding tom fills, high tension and kinetic forward momentum. Sounds like a brutal mechanical tribunal activating; oppressive, strange, memorable, polished game soundtrack. Strong beat and bass, immediately actionable battle cue, ending with a clean rhythmic phrase that can be edited into a loop. No vocals, no spoken words, no recognizable melodies, no guitar solos, no cinematic orchestra.
assets.source_archive_member: ninth exhale assets 01/THE NINTH EXHALE _ Combat_ Pneumatic Verdict.mp3

assets.title: Coil Shotgun Fire
assets.prompt: One powerful close-range discharge from a retro-industrial electromagnetic coil shotgun: rising capacitor snap, brutal low-frequency metallic THOOM, crackling blue-white electrical arc, quick sizzling decay and heavy mechanical bolt recoil. Dry and punchy, designed as a single FPS weapon firing sound, no music, no voices.

assets.title: Nail Storm Fire
assets.prompt: One vicious burst from a heavy bio-industrial pneumatic nail launcher: rapid compressed-air piston hammer CLACK-CHUFF, three tightly spaced steel rivet impacts, metallic feed-rack chatter and a short pressure-release hiss. Distinct from a conventional gunshot, aggressive close-up first-person shooter weapon effect, no music, no voices.

assets.title: Choirbreaker Fire
assets.prompt: One terrifying shot from a biomechanical acoustic cannon: guttural sub-bass pressure-wave BWAAAM, resonant metallic throat shutters snapping open, distorted choral harmonic overtone without any words, brief air-ripping shockwave decay. Singular heavy FPS weapon attack, otherworldly industrial horror, no music or speech.
